scope: Exploratory fixed-weight pooling on already examined historical forecasts; no prospective data or activation
reference: ensemble-equal-v7 for winner; historically selected v8 candidate per other target
comparators: Every component, previous best and causal league baseline on identical cases
limitations: All historical outcomes already inspected; no independent confirmatory inference.
Previously best candidates selected using this archive; optimistic reference selection.
Fixed weights not optimized on test outcomes; no post-hoc grid search.
Each market pooled separately; no claim of one coherent joint distribution across all markets.
Pooling can alter calibration; no recalibration without a separate causal calibration sample.
Agreement of models is not independent evidence; disagreement is diagnostic only.
Nine days are insufficient for strong day-block interval guarantees.
No pre-event executable odds; cannot estimate tradable EV or profit.
No changes to original prospective protocols or recorded predictions.
